description: Holds one finger on a point and releases it. Apps that time touchstart themselves see a long press; Chromium on desktop doesn't turn it into a context menu.

duration_ms.description: How long the finger stays down, in ms

window.description: Window: target id from list_windows or part of its title. Optional when only one window is open.

x.description: x coordinate, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y.description: y coordinate, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

name: long_press
title: Long press
